title: Fully compliant oat cracker label, photographed at a slight angle with light blur and noise

notes: Every requirement is genuinely satisfied. The rendering applies a 4 degree rotation, a light Gaussian blur and light pixel noise to simulate a real photograph taken at an angle under imperfect conditions, testing extraction robustness rather than compliance logic.
